name: City of Carlsbad building permits (open-data snapshot, applied 2022 to 2023)
licence: Public ArcGIS feature service published by the City of Carlsbad GIS and tagged "open data"; no login. No licence text is declared on the item.
limits: A frozen snapshot: 9,886 permits applied 2022-01-01 to 2023-12-29, last edited January 2024. Statuses are as of that date, so a permit shown as open may have been finalled since. No APN, no contractor, no valuation. 2,000 records per query. The layer lastEditDate is the change token.

name: California CSLB licence master (statewide)
licence: California Contractors State License Board public data portal. Public record; no email addresses (Business and Professions Code s.27).
limits: One CSV of about 78 MB served slowly (about 0.5 MB/s measured). The portal form postback is blocked by its firewall for scripts (HTTP 503); the direct download handler behind the form works. Only renewed or renewable licences are listed.

name: Reconciliation step (contractor identities built from CSLB master and county permit contractors)
limits: Derived from the sources above; each contractor row names the source record it came from.

name: SANDAG / SanGIS Parcels (assessor attributes, parcel centroids)
licence: Public ArcGIS feature service, no login. Attribution: SanGIS using legal recorded data from the County Recorder and Assessor.
limits: maxRecordCount 2000 per query; fetched as objectid ranges, 4 in flight. No per-row change date; the layer lastEditDate is the change token. No owner name or mailing address.

name: City of San Diego active business tax certificates
licence: City of San Diego Open Data Portal, published under the Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and Licence (PDDL) per the portal.
limits: One whole-file CSV (about 19 MB); ETag is the change token. Businesses registered with the City of San Diego only; inactive files not loaded.

name: City of San Diego development permit approvals (active and closed)
licence: City of San Diego Open Data Portal, published under the Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and Licence (PDDL) per the portal.
limits: Two whole-file CSVs (about 270 MB and 410 MB), refreshed daily; no row-level change feed, so the HTTP ETag is the change token and row hashes find the changed rows. City limits only.

name: County of San Diego building permits: contractors
licence: County of San Diego open data portal (Socrata), public, no login or app token used. No licence is declared on the dataset.
limits: SODA paging with $limit/$offset (50,000 rows per page used); anonymous requests share a throttled pool. Covers unincorporated county only. Incremental cursor: last_updated.

name: County of San Diego building permits: status history
licence: County of San Diego open data portal (Socrata), public, no login or app token used. No licence is declared on the dataset.
limits: SODA paging with $limit/$offset (50,000 rows per page used); anonymous requests share a throttled pool. Covers unincorporated county only. Incremental cursor: status_date.

name: County of San Diego building permits (unincorporated)
licence: County of San Diego open data portal (Socrata), public, no login or app token used. No licence is declared on the dataset.
limits: SODA paging with $limit/$offset (50,000 rows per page used); anonymous requests share a throttled pool. Covers unincorporated county only. Incremental cursor: last_updated.
